verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents Compliance Navigator AI™, an in-product AI feature that gives regulatory guidance tailored to the user's industry and location. That is AI-generated suggestions, but it is framed as general regulatory guidance rather than insights drawn from the user's own entity, license, and tax records. The Compliance Score's "recommended actions" is not described as AI-generated, so it adds little support. Missing for 10: evidence that the AI analyzes the user's own stored compliance data, concrete examples of insights or suggestions surfaced in the product, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
